limitations: Verified rows are bounded proposal-path capabilities, not a claim of complete editor-domain parity.

The shared browser lifecycle evidence is intentionally classified as shared-host-lifecycle; it must be replaced by operation-specific E2E evidence before a row can advance beyond bounded-proposal-path.
Every currently advertised operation declares readback=not-verified. No row claims rendered-frame, encoded-output, decoded-audio, or external-job result verification.
The Worker exposes bounded context-read and proposal-validation tools. Applying a prepared edit remains separate, explicit, approval-gated host authority.
